# load dati

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
gc()
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test_full.Rdata")
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_cleaned.Rdata")

logistica0 <- glm(goal_YN~., data=dat_cleaned, family=binomial)
summary(logistica0)
prob_log0 <- predict(logistica0, type="response", newdata=dat_test)

res <- read_csv("../creazione_dataset/games_results/serieA_2015_16_games_results.csv")
res %>% filter(home_team=="Napoli", away_team=="Juventus")
rm(res)
gc()
```


# Shots map

```{r nap-j-shots}
nap_j <- dat_test %>% mutate(my_xg=prob_log0) %>% filter(match_id=="3879548")
nap_j
library(ggsoccer)
pitch_opta[["length"]] <-  120
pitch_opta[["width"]] <-  80

nap_j %>% filter(my_xg >= 0.18) %>% view
nap_j %>% group_by(team) %>% summarise(xg_tot=sum(my_xg))

nap_j_shots <- ggplot(nap_j) +
  annotate_pitch(colour = "white",
                 fill   = "springgreen4",
                 limits = FALSE,
                 dimensions = pitch_opta) +
  geom_point(aes(x = depth_coordinate,
                 y = width_coordinate,
                 size = (my_xg * 5),
                 shape = as.factor(ifelse(goal_YN == 1, "Goal", "No Goal")),
                 colour = as.factor(team)),
             stroke = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Esito del tiro", values = c("Goal" = 8, "No Goal" = 16)) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Squadra", values = c("Napoli" = "dodgerblue", "Juventus" = "white")) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Expected Goals (xG)",
                        labels = function(x) round(x / 5, 3)) +  # Adjust legend labels
  theme_pitch() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "springgreen4")) +
  annotate("segment", x = 65, y = 83, xend = 115, yend = 83,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.4, "cm")),
           linewidth = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(60, 120))

nap_j_shots
```

# xg cumulati

```{r xg_overtime}
nap_j <- dat_test %>% mutate(my_xg=prob_log0) %>% filter(match_id=="3879548")

nap_j_1h <- nap_j[1:9,]
nap_j_2h <- nap_j[10:26,]

nap_j_1h$timestamp <- strptime(nap_j_1h$timestamp, format="%H:%M:%OS") %>% as.numeric()
nap_j_2h$timestamp <- strptime(nap_j_2h$timestamp, format="%H:%M:%OS") %>% as.numeric() + 47*60

nap_j <- rbind(nap_j_1h, nap_j_2h)

seconds_from_start <- function(t){
  (121+ as.numeric(t) - as.numeric(nap_j$timestamp[1])) / 60
}

nap_j$timestamp <- nap_j$timestamp %>% seconds_from_start()

nap_j <- nap_j %>%
  add_row(nap_j[1,] %>%
        mutate(timestamp=0, team="Juventus", my_xg=0),.before = 1) %>%
  
  add_row(nap_j[1,] %>%
        mutate(timestamp=0, team="Napoli", my_xg=0),.before = 1)


# Calculate cumulative xG for each team
nap_j <- nap_j %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(cum_xg = cumsum(my_xg)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Function to create Manhattan segments
manhattan_segments <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    arrange(timestamp) %>%
    mutate(x_start = lag(timestamp, default = first(timestamp)),
           x_end = timestamp,
           y_start = lag(cum_xg, default = first(cum_xg)),
           y_end = cum_xg) %>%
    select(team, x_start, x_end, y_start, y_end)
}

# Create the segments for both teams
segments_juve <- manhattan_segments(nap_j %>% filter(team == "Juventus"))
segments_napoli <- manhattan_segments(nap_j %>% filter(team == "Napoli"))

library(ggdark)

xg_overtime <- ggplot(nap_j %>% filter(team == "Juventus")) +

  geom_segment(data = segments_juve,
               aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y_start, yend = y_start),
               colour = "white", size = 1) +
  
  geom_segment(data = segments_juve,
               aes(x = x_end, xend = x_end, y = y_start, yend = y_end),
               colour = "white", size = 1) +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = timestamp, y = cumsum(my_xg),
                 shape = as.factor(ifelse(goal_YN == 1, "Goal", "No Goal")), 
                 colour = as.factor(team)), 
             size = 3) +

  geom_segment(data = segments_napoli,
               aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y_start, yend = y_start),
               colour = "dodgerblue", size = 1) +
  
  geom_segment(data = segments_napoli,
               aes(x = x_end, xend = x_end, y = y_start, yend = y_end),
               colour = "dodgerblue", size = 1) +
  
  geom_point(data = nap_j %>% filter(team == "Napoli"),
             aes(x = timestamp, y = cumsum(my_xg),
                 shape = as.factor(ifelse(goal_YN == 1, "Goal", "No Goal")), 
                 colour = as.factor(team)), 
             size = 3) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Esito del tiro", values = c("Goal" = 8, "No Goal" = 16)) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Squadra", values = c("Napoli" = "dodgerblue", "Juventus" = "white")) +

  dark_theme_gray() +
  labs(x = "Minuto",
       y = "xG cumulati",
       colour = "Squadra") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(nap_j$timestamp), max(nap_j$timestamp), by = 5)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")

xg_overtime
```
